card.name: Small words inside fixed label phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or", "of" and "acute" in repeated drug-label sentences, just before a medical noun like blood loss, depression or pain.

modes.label: or before blood loss
modes.description: The word "or" between "occult" and "gross blood loss" in the NSAID anemia warning.
modes.example: This may be due to occult<< or>> gross blood loss, fluid retention, or

modes.label: of after recurrence
modes.description: The word "of" after "recurrence" in the antidepressant maintenance-trial sentence.
modes.example: can delay the recurrence<< of>> depression. All patients being treated with antidepress

modes.label: acute before pain
modes.description: The adjective "acute" before "pain" in an NSAID indication.
modes.example: management of moderately severe<< acute>> pain that requires analgesia at the

card.plain: It fires on a small word in a stock label sentence just before the key condition is named.
